title: Device for removing plate-shaped elements, in particular cardboard blanks

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
features.quote: The device 1 comprises a drive 7 . The drive 7 drives a shaft 8 .
features.note: The reference discloses a drive (7) that drives a shaft (8), which is an electrically operated vacuum generating device.
features.refuted: The quote describes a drive and shaft but does not teach that it is a vacuum generating device.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
A suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal fastened to the carrier plate extending around it
features.quote: A carrier device 16 is additionally provided. A holding device 9 is mounted on the carrier device 16 . A plurality of suction apparatuses 10 are disposed on the holding device 9 .
features.note: The reference discloses a carrier device (16) and suction apparatuses (10) on a holding device (9), which could be considered a suction plate, but it does not explicitly mention a seal fastened to the carrier plate extending around it.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device in grip
Vacuum handling apparatus with suction plate and grip unit combined
features.quote: The present invention relates to a device ( 1 ) for removing plate-shaped elements ( 2 ), in particular cardboard blanks, comprising a carrier device ( 16 ), a holding device ( 9 ) which is arranged on the carrier
features.note: The reference describes a device for removing plate-shaped elements with a carrier device and a holding device, which functions as a vacuum handling apparatus with a suction plate. However, it does not explicitly describe a 'grip unit' as defined by the subject invention.

features.item: Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
features.note: The reference mentions a drive (7) and shaft (8) but does not specify its arrangement within a 'first housing portion' or any housing portions.

features.item: Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
features.note: The reference describes a carrier device and holding device, but does not mention a 'grip unit' or a releasable connection between a grip unit and a suction plate.

features.item: Grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate
features.note: The reference describes suction apparatuses on a holding device, but does not mention a 'grip unit' or a suction chamber delimited by a suction plate.

claims.note: The reference describes a device for removing plate-shaped elements, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device.
The reference describes a device with a carrier and holding device, not a housing with a grip portion and an electrically operated vacuum generating device.
The reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body.
The reference does not describe exhaust air being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet.
This reference describes a device for removing plate-shaped elements using levers and a holding device, but it does not mention any sound-damping device in a grip portion.
This reference describes a device for removing plate-shaped elements and does not mention a grip portion lined with sound-damping material.
This reference describes a device for removing plate-shaped elements and does not mention a vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion.
This reference describes a device for removing plate-shaped elements and does not mention a sound-reducing device in a housing portion or a housing portion lined with sound-reducing material.
This reference describes a device for removing plate-shaped elements using levers and a holding device, but it does not mention a grip unit, housing portions, or an air outlet.
This reference describes a device for removing plate-shaped elements using levers and a holding device, but it does not mention an air collection device, air collection screw, or exhaust air.
This reference describes a device for removing plate-shaped elements using levers and a holding device, but it does not mention air baffles or guiding exhaust air.

This reference describes a device for removing plate-shaped elements using levers and a holding device, but it does not mention a battery coupling point, electrical energy storage device, or rechargeable battery.
This reference does not disclose air baffles for directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.
This reference describes a device for removing plate-shaped elements, not a vacuum handling apparatus.
This reference does not disclose a suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal fastened to it.
This reference does not disclose a grip unit as described in claim 1 of the subject invention.
This reference does not disclose a grip unit and a suction plate being releasably connected via a coupling device.
This reference does not disclose a grip unit with a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber to generate a vacuum between a suction plate and an object.

overall.why: The reference describes a device for handling plate-shaped elements using suction and a lever mechanism, which is related to vacuum handling apparatuses, but it lacks specific details about the grip portion, sound damping, and exhaust air routing as described in the subject features.
